endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchContacts
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including relationships with partners, departments, and complex filters. This endpoint supports complex, structured searches using the 'searchCriteria' parameter. The 'searchCriteria' should be a JSON array of objects, where each object has 'field', 'operator', and 'value' properties. Fields can be direct (e.g., 'firstName', 'email') or nested (e.g., 'partner.name', 'partner.status'). Available operators include 'like', 'is', 'not', 'contains', 'startsWith', 'endsWith', 'between', 'greaterThan', 'lessThan', 'greaterThanOrEqual', 'lessThanOrEqual', 'on', 'not on', 'this week', 'this month', 'this year'. For date fields like 'createdDate' or 'modifiedDate', use date-specific operators. Example: `[{"field": "firstName", "operator": "like", "value": "John"}, {"field": "partner.name", "operator": "is", "value": "UNICEF"}]`

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Find contacts from UNICEF partner organization
Show contacts in Finance department created this month
Get contacts working at Asian Infrastructure partners
Find contacts where partner status is Active
List contacts from climate-related interactions
Search for contacts by department and creation date
